commit 347fc31ddd227674d8dc93e238d6664784e1872d

Vanilla Web Animations slot: five reels, a spin button, autoplay.
Upstream ships Star Wars–style icons by KPD Media (IconStore: personal
and commercial use, no attribution; redistribution of the icon pack is
not allowed). This port keeps the reel engine and draws its own fruit
symbols instead, so the GIF does not redistribute that pack.

Webpack, the bootstrap reboot CDN, and the photo backgrounds stay
behind. Credits live in a private save. Press Invite and everyone in
the room sees the same reels.
